mapper.sql: select id, project_id, scheme_id, apply_time, apply_time_notice, contact, phone, email,contact_notice, phone_notice, email_notice, template_id, attach_id,attach_id_notice, vendor_range, create_by, create_id, create_time, update_by, update_id, update_time, del_flag, notice_status, is_open_people, is_eval, wf_process_id,twice_time,twice_quot_version,twice_quot_state,payment_type from tb_tender_notice
mapper.select:
SELECT ps.procurement_scheme_code, ps.procurement_scheme_name, tn.create_time, tn.notice_status, tn.id noticeId, tn.scheme_id, br.publicity_start_time, br.publicity_end_time, su.thrid_org_name unit FROM tb_tender_notice tn LEFT JOIN tb_procurement_scheme ps ON ps.id = tn.scheme_id AND ps.del_flag = 0 inner join tb_bidding_result br ON br.notice_id = tn.id and br.scheme_id = tn.scheme_id left join sys_user su on su.user_id = ps.procurement_officer where tn.del_flag = 0 and tn.notice_status >= #{queryDTO.noticeStatus} and br.publicity_start_time is not null and br.publicity_end_time is not null and br.rank = 1
and ps.procurement_plan_type = #{queryDTO.procurementPlanType}
and ps.procurement_scheme_name like CONCAT('%', #{queryDTO.procurementSchemeName}, '%')
order by tn.create_time desc

select tn.*, ps.procurement_type schemeType, ps.procurement_scheme_name as procurementSchemeName, ps.project_code as projectCode from tb_tender_notice tn inner join tb_procurement_scheme ps on ps.id = tn.scheme_id where tn.id = #{id} and tn.del_flag = 0 and ps.del_flag = 0
